typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	Changethistable_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Status as string,
		Auth as string,
		Ack as string,
		{ACK (S)} as string,
		{ACK (D)} as string,
		{From Account} as string,
		{To Account} as string,
		Currency as string,
		{Sweep Date} as string,
		{Sweep Amount} as string,
		{Payment Ledger} as string,
		Note as string,
		{Legal Entity} as string,
		{From Beneficiary ID} as string,
		{From Beneficiary} as string,
		{To Beneficiary ID} as string,
		{To Beneficiary} as string,
		{Created by} as string,
		{Created on} as string,
		{Last Actioned By} as string,
		{Last Actioned On} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> fromFile1
fromFile1 derive(Load_Date = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		Status as string,
		Last_Actioned_By as string,
		From_Beneficiary as string,
		Created_on as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Sweep_Date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Ack as string,
		To_Account as string,
		Load_Date as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Legal_Entity as string,
		To_Beneficiary_ID as integer,
		From_Beneficiary_ID as integer,
		ACK_S as string,
		Payment_Ledger as string,
		Auth as string,
		Currency as string,
		Note as string,
		Sweep_Amount as double,
		From_Account as string,
		Last_Actioned_On as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Created_by as string,
		To_Beneficiary as string,
		ACK_D as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Status,
		Last_Actioned_By = {Last Actioned By},
		From_Beneficiary = {From Beneficiary},
		Created_on = {Created on},
		Sweep_Date = {Sweep Date},
		Ack,
		To_Account = {To Account},
		Load_Date,
		Legal_Entity = {Legal Entity},
		To_Beneficiary_ID = {To Beneficiary ID},
		From_Beneficiary_ID = {From Beneficiary ID},
		ACK_S = {ACK (S)},
		Payment_Ledger = {Payment Ledger},
		Auth,
		Currency,
		Note,
		Sweep_Amount = {Sweep Amount},
		From_Account = {From Account},
		Last_Actioned_On = {Last Actioned On},
		Created_by = {Created by},
		To_Beneficiary = {To Beneficiary},
		ACK_D = {ACK (D)}),
	partitionFileNames:[($Changethistable_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> Changethistable
